name: Military Ward
summary: Red banners mark the Military Ward, where Ironforge's defenders gather and train. Its command halls, weapons masters, barracks, siege engines, and flying machines serve the mountain city's military.

sections.title: The Anvil of Dwarven Might
sections.body: The Military Ward gathers Ironforge's defenses in a busy staging ground along the northern edge of the mountain fortress. At its center, the Hall of Arms holds warrior and hunter trainers and battlemasters, with hangars for dwarven flying machines and steam tanks. Around the drill squares and training dummies, supply shops include Craghelm's Plate and Chain, Goldfury's Hunting Supplies, and Timberline Arms. The ward is Ironforge's main staging point for mountaineers and city defenders.

sections.title: A Garrison under Banners of War
sections.body: Red banners cover the Military Ward, setting it apart from the Commons' pale blue and the Great Forge's fiery orange. Between drills and weapons inspections, soldiers and off-duty guards gather for ale at Bruuk's Corner. Weapon Master Buliwyf Stonehand teaches recruits the ancient martial traditions of the dwarves.

faq.answer: The Military Ward is where Ironforge's dwarven army gathers, alongside warrior and hunter trainers, weapons merchants, and siege machinery.

faq.q: Where can I train in weapons in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Weapon Master Buliwyf Stonehand teaches weapons at Timberline Arms in the Military Ward, training Alliance fighters in various armaments.

faq.q: What is kept inside the Hall of Arms?
aliases: what is in hall of arms
faq.answer: The Hall of Arms holds combat instructors and battlemasters, with large bays for steam tanks and dwarven flying machines.

faq.q: Why are the banners red in this district?
faq.answer: The Military Ward's bold red banners mark the martial arm of Ironforge, whose districts use distinct heraldic colors for navigation and tradition.

angles.text: The Military Ward is Ironforge's chief martial hub, with warrior trainers, training dummies for combat practice, and weapon masters to broaden your battlefield arsenal.
Rangers and mountaineers find beast masters and supplies in the Hall of Arms, alongside munitions and gear at Goldfury's Hunting Supplies.
